<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>LGCY Power · Field Rep Hub</title>
<!-- LGCY Brand Fonts: Sequel 100 Black (embedded) + DM Sans (body) -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Sequel100Black75';
  src: url('data:font/truetype;base64,') format('truetype');
  font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Sequel100Black45';
  src: url('data:font/truetype;base64,') format('truetype');
  font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
}
</style>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css">
<style>
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════
   LGCY POWER BRAND TOKENS
   Primary: #F27732 (LGCY Orange)
   Near-black: #1A1815
   Headline: Bebas Neue (proxies Sequel 100 Black 65)
   Body: DM Sans
════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root {
  /* Brand Core */
  --orange:#FE0942;   --orange2:#FE0942;  --orange3:#FE0942;
  --orange-dim:#FE0942;
  --teal:#2C8E9B;     --teal2:#91BFBF;    --teal3:#3DC0CC;
  --yellow:#FEC355;   --yellow2:#FFD188;
  --green:#828E3F;    --green2:#9DB16B;
  --purple:#7050B8;   --purple2:#8F6ED0;  --purple3:#AD95E8;

  /* Dark Background System */
  --bg:#1D1D1D;   --bg2:#000;  --bg3:#000;  --bg4:#000;  --bg5:#000;
  --border:#32A;  --border2:#32A;  --border3:#32A;

  /* Text */
  --text:#F0ECE5;  --text2:#B0AA9F;  --text3:#706A60;  --text4:#4A4540;

  /* Gradients */
  --orange-grd:linear-gradient(135deg,#FE0942,#FE8E9D,#FECED6);
  --orange-grd2:linear-gradient(135deg,#0059FF,#00D4FF,#85F4FF);
  --teal-grd:linear-gradient(135deg,#FE0942,#FF2F67,#FF5C9C);
  --yellow-grd:linear-gradient(135deg,#483EC5,#4E48CE,#89B9F8);
  --green-grd:linear-gradient(135deg,#A8E6CF,#DCF2E8,#EBF7F2);
  --purple-grd:linear-gradient(135deg,#DF00FE,#DF00FE,#DCC4FF);

  /* Radii */
  --rad:12px;  --rad-sm:8px;  --rad-xs:5px;  --rad-pill:100px;

  /* Layout */
  --hdr:56px;  --bnav:62px;
}

/* ── Light mode card depth ── */
[data-theme="light"] .gc{box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .gc:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14);border-color:rgba(242,119,50,.5);}
[data-theme="light"] .fc{box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .cc{box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .qbtn{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
[data-theme="light"] .qbtn:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}
[data-theme="light"] .fav-card{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.09);border-color:rgba(180,140,40,.35);}
[data-theme="light"] .v-card{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.09);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .hdr{box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}
[data-theme="light"] .sidebar{box-shadow:2px 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
[data-theme="light"] .bnav{box-shadow:0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.10);}
[data-theme="light"] .avl-cfg{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .hero{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
[data-theme="light"] .seg{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.10);}
[data-theme="light"] .seg-btn.active{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.14);}
[data-theme="light"] .avl-tabs{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
[data-theme="light"] .cmp-modal,[data-theme="light"] .op-modal{box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
[data-theme="light"] .live-badge{background:rgba(80,110,40,.1);border-color:rgba(80,110,40,.35);color:#3A5020;font-weight:700;}
[data-theme="light"] .live-badge.cached{background:rgba(160,100,20,.1);border-color:rgba(160,100,20,.35);color:#7A4A08;font-weight:700;}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg:#EAE6DF;   --bg2:#F8F5F0;  --bg3:#FFFFFF;  --bg4:#EDE9E2;  --bg5:#E0DBD2;
  --border:#D0C9BE;  --border2:#B8AFA2;  --border3:#A09690;
  --text:#111009;  --text2:#3A3530;  --text3:#726A60;  --text4:#A09890;
}

@media(min-width:900px){
  body{background:#110F0D;}
  [data-theme="light"] body{background:#CEC8BE;}
  #app{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;border-left:1px solid var(--border2);border-right:1px solid var(--border2);box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7);}
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}

/* ─── APP SHELL ─── */
#app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);}

/* ════════════════════
   HEADER
════════════════════ */
.hdr{
  height:var(--hdr);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:0 16px;background:var(--bg2);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink:0;z-index:20;position:relative;
}
.hdr::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:var(--orange-grd);opacity:.5;
}
@media(min-width:900px){.hdr{z-index:50;padding:0 24px;}}

.hdr-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;}
.hdr-bolt{
  width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--orange-grd);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(242,119,50,.45);
}
.hdr-name{
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.05em;white-space:nowrap;
  line-height:1;
}
.hdr-name span{
  display:block;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text3);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:1px;
}
.hdr-div{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--border2);flex-shrink:0;}

.srch-wrap{flex:1;position:relative;min-width:0;max-width:480px;}
.srch-wrap i{position:absolute;left:11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;}
#srch{
  width:100%;padding:8px 10px 8px 31px;
  border-radius:var(--rad-pill);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
  background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;outline:none;
  transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
#srch:focus{border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(242,119,50,.12);}

.theme-btn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;}
.theme-btn:hover{border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(242,119,50,.15);}
#theme-ico.fa-sun{color:#F5A623;}
#theme-ico.fa-moon{color:#818CF8;}

/* ════════════════════
   SEARCH OVERLAY
════════════════════ */
.srch-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:200;flex-direction:column;animation:fadeDown .18s ease;}
.srch-overlay.open{display:flex;}
@keyframes fadeDown{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.srch-ov-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;}
.srch-ov-hdr input{flex:1;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);border:1.5px solid var(--orange);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:15px;outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(242,119,50,.12);}
.srch-ov-cancel{padding:7px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;background:none;border:none;color:var(--teal2);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:16px;}
.srch-results{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:10px 16px 100px;}
.srch-sec{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--text3);padding:14px 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:4px;}
.srch-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s;}
.srch-item:last-child{border:none;}
.srch-item:active{opacity:.6;}
.srch-ico{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border2);}
.srch-label{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;}
.srch-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:1px;}
.srch-empty{text-align:center;padding:50px 20px;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;}

/* ════════════════════
   MODE SWITCHER
════════════════════ */
.seg-wrap{padding:6px 14px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px;}
.seg-btn{
  flex:1;padding:6px 20px;text-align:center;
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.07em;
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);background:transparent;
  transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);
  border:none;border-radius:8px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
  position:relative;
}
.seg-btn i{font-size:11px;transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s;}
.seg-btn:active{transform:scale(.95);}
/* Active: colored gradient pill per section */
.seg-btn[data-mode="guides"].active{
  background:var(--orange-grd);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(242,119,50,.45);
}
.seg-btn[data-mode="guides"].active i{color:#fff;transform:scale(1.15);}
.seg-btn[data-mode="sheets"].active{
  background:var(--teal-grd);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(44,142,155,.45);
}
.seg-btn[data-mode="sheets"].active i{color:#fff;transform:scale(1.15);}
.seg-btn[data-mode="videos"].active{
  background:var(--purple-grd);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(126,105,200,.45);
}
.seg-btn[data-mode="videos"].active i{color:#fff;transform:scale(1.15);}
/* Idle icon colors */
.seg-btn[data-mode="guides"] i{color:var(--orange);}
.seg-btn[data-mode="sheets"] i{color:var(--teal);}
.seg-btn[data-mode="videos"] i{color:var(--purple);}
.seg-btn:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--text2);transform:scale(1.02);}
/* Light mode active shadows */
[data-theme="light"] .seg-btn[data-mode="guides"].active{box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(242,119,50,.35);}
[data-theme="light"] .seg-btn[data-mode="sheets"].active{box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(44,142,155,.35);}
[data-theme="light"] .seg-btn[data-mode="videos"].active{box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(126,105,200,.35);}

/* ════════════════════
   LAYOUT
════════════════════ */
.layout{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden;}
.sidebar{display:none;}
.content{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .layout{flex:1;overflow:hidden;}
  .sidebar{display:flex!important;width:188px;flex-shrink:0;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;}
  .sb-scroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px 6px 30px;}
  .content{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .seg-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
}

/* ════════════════════
   SIDEBAR
════════════════════ */
.sb-scroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px 6px 30px;}
.ns{margin-bottom:0;}
.ns-btn{
  width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:5px 7px;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);background:none;border:none;
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--text2);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.02em;
  transition:background .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;
}
.ns-btn:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);}
.ns-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.ns-arrow{font-size:10px;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
.ns.open .ns-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg);}
.ns-body{display:none;padding:0 0 2px 4px;animation:fadeUp .15s ease;}
.ns.open .ns-body{display:block;}
.nl{
  width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:5px;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);border:none;
  background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text2);
  font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;
  margin-bottom:1px;transition:background .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;
}
.nl:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);}
.nl.active{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(242,119,50,.18),rgba(242,119,50,.04));color:var(--orange2);border-left:2px solid var(--orange);}
.nl.dis{opacity:.42;cursor:default;}
.nl.dis:hover{background:none;}
.nl-txt{flex:1;text-align:left;line-height:1.3;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.chip{padding:1px 5px;border-radius:20px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(242,119,50,.12);border:1px solid rgba(242,119,50,.28);color:var(--orange2);white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}
.chip.soon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--text3);}
[data-theme="light"] .chip.soon{background:rgba(0,0,0,.04);border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.ns:nth-child(1) .ns-btn i{color:var(--orange2);}
.ns:nth-child(2) .ns-btn i{color:var(--yellow2);}
.ns:nth-child(3) .ns-btn i{color:var(--teal2);}
.ns:nth-child(4) .ns-btn i{color:var(--green2);}
.ns:nth-child(5) .ns-btn i{color:var(--purple2);}
.ns:nth-child(6) .ns-btn i{color:#60A5FA;}

/* ════════════════════
   PANES
════════════════════ */
.pane{display:none;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px 16px 24px;}
.pane.active{display:block;animation:fadeUp .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
#pane-viewer{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;padding:0!important;}
#pane-viewer.active{display:flex;}
@media(min-width:900px){.pane{padding:20px 24px 40px;}}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}

/* ════════════════════
   HERO BANNERS
════════════════════ */
.hero{border-radius:var(--rad);padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-default{background:linear-gradient(145deg, #000, #000 60%,transparent);border:1px solid #32A;}
.hero-teal{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(44,142,155,.13),rgba(44,142,155,.03) 60%,transparent);border:1px solid rgba(44,142,155,.25);}
.hero-yellow{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(254,195,85,.13),rgba(254,195,85,.03) 60%,transparent);border:1px solid rgba(254,195,85,.25);}
.hero-purple{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(112,80,184,.13),rgba(112,80,184,.03) 60%,transparent);border:1px solid rgba(112,80,184,.25);}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;}
.hero-default::before{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.hero-teal::before{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.hero-yellow::before{background:var(--yellow-grd);}
.hero-purple::before{background:var(--purple-grd);}
.hero-bg-glyph{position:absolute;right:-8px;bottom:-18px;font-size:110px;opacity:.04;pointer-events:none;line-height:1;}
.hero-tag{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--orange2);margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.hero-tag i{font-size:10px;}
.hero h1{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.0;margin-bottom:6px;}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--orange2);}
.hero p{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55;max-width:520px;}

/* ════════════════════
   SECTION LABELS
════════════════════ */
.slabel{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--text3);margin:16px 0 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.slabel::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border);}

/* ════════════════════
   QUICK ACCESS
════════════════════ */
.qgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:18px;}
@media(min-width:480px){.qgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);}}
.qbtn{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:5px;
  padding:13px 11px;background:var(--bg3);
  border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),background .2s,box-shadow .2s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.qbtn::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;}
.qbtn.q-or::after{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.qbtn.q-tl::after{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.qbtn.q-yl::after{background:var(--yellow-grd);}
.qbtn.q-gr::after{background:var(--green-grd);}
.qbtn.q-pu::after{background:var(--purple-grd);}
.qbtn:hover{background:var(--bg4);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.qbtn:active{transform:translateY(0);}
.qbtn.q-or:hover{border-color:rgba(242,119,50,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(242,119,50,.12);}
.qbtn.q-tl:hover{border-color:rgba(44,142,155,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(44,142,155,.12);}
.qbtn.q-yl:hover{border-color:rgba(254,195,85,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(254,195,85,.12);}
.qbtn.q-gr:hover{border-color:rgba(130,142,63,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(130,142,63,.12);}
.qbtn.q-pu:hover{border-color:rgba(112,80,184,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(112,80,184,.12);}
.qico{font-size:19px;line-height:1;}
.qlbl{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1.2;color:var(--text2);}
.qsub{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.2;}
.qbtn.q-or .qico i{color:var(--orange2);}
.qbtn.q-tl .qico i{color:var(--teal2);}
.qbtn.q-yl .qico i{color:var(--yellow2);}
.qbtn.q-gr .qico i{color:var(--green2);}
.qbtn.q-pu .qico i{color:var(--purple2);}

/* ════════════════════
   FAVORITES
════════════════════ */
#fav-section{margin-bottom:18px;display:none;}
.fav-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px;}
@media(min-width:480px){.fav-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
.fav-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid rgba(254,195,85,.22);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);padding:11px 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .18s,transform .18s,box-shadow .18s;}
.fav-card:hover{border-color:rgba(254,195,85,.6);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(254,195,85,.1);}
.fav-ico{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
.fav-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:1.15;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex:1;}
.fav-sec{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:1px;}
.fav-rm{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--yellow2);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;opacity:.55;flex-shrink:0;transition:opacity .15s,background .15s;}
.fav-rm:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(254,195,85,.15);}

/* ════════════════════
   GUIDE CARDS
════════════════════ */
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:20px;}
@media(min-width:560px){.cgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
@media(min-width:1100px){.cgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
@media(min-width:1300px){.cgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}}
.gc{
  background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--rad);
  padding:15px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),box-shadow .2s;
}
.gc::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--orange);opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s;}
.gc:hover{border-color:rgba(242,119,50,.45);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
.gc:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.gc:hover .gc-star{opacity:1;}
.gc:hover .garrow{opacity:1;transform:translateX(3px);}
.gc:active{transform:translateY(0);}
.gc.dis{opacity:.4;cursor:default;}
.gc.dis:hover{border-color:var(--border);transform:none;box-shadow:none;}
.gc.dis::before{display:none;}
.gc-sec{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--orange2);}
.gc-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:1.15;}
.gc-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;flex:1;}
.gc-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:5px;}
.gbadge{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(242,119,50,.12);border:1px solid rgba(242,119,50,.28);color:var(--orange2);}
.gbadge.soon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--text3);}
[data-theme="light"] .gbadge.soon{background:rgba(0,0,0,.04);border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.garrow{font-size:15px;color:var(--orange2);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
.gc-star{position:absolute;top:9px;right:9px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;opacity:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);border:none;cursor:pointer;z-index:2;transition:opacity .15s,background .15s,transform .2s;}
.gc-star:hover{background:rgba(254,195,85,.2);transform:scale(1.2);}
.gc-star.starred{opacity:1;color:var(--yellow2);background:rgba(254,195,85,.12);}
[data-theme="light"] .gc-star{background:rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
mark{background:rgba(242,119,50,.22);color:var(--orange2);border-radius:2px;padding:0 2px;}

/* ════════════════════
   VIEWER
════════════════════ */
.viewer-bar{height:50px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 14px;flex-shrink:0;}
.vback{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text);background:none;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s;}
.vback:hover{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange2);}
.vtitle{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.vext{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;border:1.5px solid var(--teal);color:var(--teal2);background:rgba(44,142,155,.08);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0;}
.vext:hover{background:rgba(44,142,155,.18);}
.vshare{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;border:1.5px solid var(--green);color:var(--green2);background:rgba(130,142,63,.08);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;flex-shrink:0;}
.vshare:hover{background:rgba(130,142,63,.18);}
.gframe-wrap{flex:1;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;}
#gframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;}

/* ════════════════════
   FINANCE
════════════════════ */
.fgrid{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-bottom:20px;}
@media(min-width:560px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
.fc{background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad);padding:17px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),box-shadow .2s;}
.fc:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
.fc:active{transform:translateY(0);}
.fc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;}
.fc.or::before{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.fc.tl::before{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.fc.yl::before{background:var(--yellow-grd);}
.fc.gr::before{background:var(--green-grd);}
.fc-name{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:2px;}
.fc-type{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text3);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:9px;}
.fc-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;}
.fc-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.fc-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);}
[data-theme="light"] .fc-tag{background:rgba(0,0,0,.04);}
.fc-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.06em;background:var(--orange-grd);color:#fff;}

/* ════════════════════
   LIVE BADGE
════════════════════ */
.live-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;
  background:rgba(130,142,63,.1);border:1px solid rgba(130,142,63,.3);color:var(--green2);
}
.live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green2);animation:pulse 2s infinite;display:inline-block;box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green2);}
.live-badge.cached{background:rgba(254,195,85,.1);border-color:rgba(254,195,85,.3);color:var(--yellow2);}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.8);}}

/* ════════════════════
   AVL TABS (smooth + colored)
════════════════════ */
.avl-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);margin-bottom:14px;background:var(--bg3);}
.avl-tab{
  flex:1;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center;
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;
  cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);background:transparent;border:none;
  transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;
}
.avl-tab i{font-size:10px;transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s;}
.avl-tab:active{transform:scale(.95);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="finance"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(44,142,155,.5);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="finance"].active i{color:#fff!important;transform:scale(1.2);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="equip"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(242,119,50,.5);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="equip"].active i{color:#fff!important;transform:scale(1.2);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="adders"].active{background:var(--green-grd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(130,142,63,.5);}
.avl-tab[data-avltab="adders"].active i{color:#fff!important;transform:scale(1.2);}
.avl-tab:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--text2);transform:scale(1.02);}
.avl-srch{width:100%;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;outline:none;display:block;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.avl-srch:focus{border-color:var(--yellow2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(254,195,85,.12);}
.avl-op-bar{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);align-items:center;}

/* ════════════════════
   ONE-PAGER PILLS & COMPARE
════════════════════ */
.op-pill{
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  transition:border-color .18s,color .18s,background .18s,box-shadow .18s;
}
.op-pill:hover{border-color:var(--yellow2);color:var(--yellow2);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(254,195,85,.15);}
.cmp-pill{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 13px;
  border-radius:var(--rad-pill);background:var(--orange-grd);
  border:none;color:#fff;
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .18s,box-shadow .18s;white-space:nowrap;
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(242,119,50,.4);
}
.cmp-pill:hover{opacity:.88;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(242,119,50,.55);}

/* ════════════════════
   AVL TABLE
════════════════════ */
.avl-table-outer{overflow-x:auto;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);margin-bottom:12px;}
.avl-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:480px;}
.avl-table th{background:var(--bg3);padding:9px 12px;text-align:left;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text3);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border2);}
.avl-table td{padding:8px 12px;font-size:12.5px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle;}
.avl-table tr:last-child td{border:none;}
.avl-table tr:hover td{background:var(--bg4);}
.avl-yes{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:rgba(130,142,63,.15);color:var(--green2);border:1px solid rgba(130,142,63,.3);margin:1px 2px;}
.avl-no-mark{color:var(--text3);}
.avl-no-results{text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;}

/* ════════════════════
   AVL EQUIPMENT
════════════════════ */
.avl-lender-section{margin-bottom:22px;}
.avl-lender-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border2);color:var(--orange2);}
.avl-config-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:9px;}
.avl-cfg{background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);padding:13px;transition:border-color .18s,box-shadow .18s;}
.avl-cfg:hover{border-color:var(--border3);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.avl-cfg-type{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px;}
.avl-cfg-type.tpo{background:rgba(44,142,155,.12);color:var(--teal2);border:1px solid rgba(44,142,155,.25);}
.avl-cfg-type.loan{background:rgba(130,142,63,.12);color:var(--green2);border:1px solid rgba(130,142,63,.25);}
.avl-cfg-market{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:3px;}
.avl-cfg-config{font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.4;}
.avl-cfg-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
.avl-cfg-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;}
.avl-cfg-key{color:var(--text3);font-weight:600;min-width:62px;flex-shrink:0;}
.avl-cfg-val{color:var(--text2);line-height:1.4;}

/* ── State filter chips ── */
.state-filter-bar{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.state-chip{
  padding:3px 8px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.05em;
  background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text3);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);white-space:nowrap;
}
.state-chip.active{background:var(--teal-grd);border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(44,142,155,.3);}
.state-chip:not(.active):hover{border-color:var(--teal2);color:var(--teal2);}

/* ── Lender filter buttons ── */
.avl-lf-btn{
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;
  background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);
}
.avl-lf-btn.active{background:var(--yellow-grd);color:#211F1E;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(254,195,85,.25);}
.avl-lf-btn:not(.active):hover{border-color:var(--yellow2);color:var(--yellow2);}

/* ════════════════════
   ADDERS
════════════════════ */
.adder-section-hdr{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--green2);padding:12px 0 6px;border-top:2px solid rgba(130,142,63,.2);margin-top:10px;}
.adder-section-hdr:first-child{border-top:none;margin-top:0;}
.adder-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin-bottom:14px;}
.adder-table th{background:var(--bg3);padding:7px 10px;text-align:left;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text3);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border2);}
.adder-table td{padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:top;}
.adder-table tr:last-child td{border:none;}
.adder-name{font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;}
.adder-note{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4;}
.adder-price-val{color:var(--green2);font-weight:700;}
.adder-price-empty{color:var(--text3);}
.adder-filter-btn{
  padding:5px 11px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);
}
.adder-filter-btn.active{background:var(--green-grd);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(130,142,63,.25);}
.adder-filter-btn:not(.active):hover{border-color:var(--green2);color:var(--green2);}
.adder-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;}

/* ════════════════════
   SUNGAGE
════════════════════ */
.sg-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);margin-bottom:14px;}
.sg-tab{flex:1;padding:9px;text-align:center;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.07em;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);background:var(--bg3);border:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s;}
.sg-tab.active{background:#FEC355;color:#211F1E;}
.sg-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);margin-bottom:12px;}
.sg-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:360px;}
.sg-table th{background:var(--bg3);padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text3);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border2);}
.sg-table td{padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.sg-table tr:last-child td{border:none;}
.sg-hi{color:#FEC355;font-weight:700;}
.callout{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.5;}
.callout.y{background:rgba(254,195,85,.07);border:1px solid rgba(254,195,85,.2);color:var(--text2);}
.callout.g{background:rgba(130,142,63,.07);border:1px solid rgba(130,142,63,.2);color:var(--text2);}

/* ════════════════════
   VIDEOS (redesigned — horizontal card, side play btn, colored filter pills)
════════════════════ */
.v-filter-bar{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 0 4px;}
.v-filter-btn{
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  border:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text3);
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  transition:all .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);white-space:nowrap;
}
.v-filter-btn i{font-size:10px;}
.v-filter-btn:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);border-color:var(--border3);color:var(--text2);}
.v-filter-btn.active{border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
/* Per-category filter colors */
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="All"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Pricing & Pay"].active{background:var(--yellow-grd);color:#211F1E!important;}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Proposals & Tools"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Rep Workflows"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Operations"].active{background:var(--green-grd);color:#fff;}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Aurora Solar"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.v-filter-btn[data-cat="Sunrun"].active{background:var(--purple-grd);}

.v-section-label{
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  color:var(--text3);margin:22px 0 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.v-section-label::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border);}

/* Video grid — 2 cols on wider screens */
.v-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;}
@media(min-width:640px){.v-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}

.v-card{
  background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);
  overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch;
  transition:border-color .18s,transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),box-shadow .18s;
  position:relative;
}
.v-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;
  background:var(--v-accent,var(--purple2));opacity:.7;
  transition:opacity .18s,width .18s;
}
.v-card:hover{border-color:var(--v-accent,var(--purple2));transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}
.v-card:hover::before{opacity:1;width:4px;}
.v-card:active{transform:scale(.98);}

.v-play-side{
  width:48px;min-width:48px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
  background:var(--bg4);
  transition:background .18s;
}
.v-card:hover .v-play-side{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--v-accent,var(--purple2)) 12%,var(--bg4));}
.v-play-circle{
  width:30px;height:30px;
  background:var(--v-accent,var(--purple2));
  border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),box-shadow .2s;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.v-card:hover .v-play-circle{transform:scale(1.18);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.v-play-circle i{font-size:10px;color:#fff;margin-left:2px;}

.v-info{padding:9px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:0;}
.v-label{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;color:var(--text);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;}
.v-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:20px;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;
  background:rgba(143,110,208,.12);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--v-accent,var(--purple2)) 12%,transparent);
  color:var(--v-accent,var(--purple2));
  border:1px solid rgba(143,110,208,.2);
  border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--v-accent,var(--purple2)) 25%,transparent);
  align-self:flex-start;
}

/* Per-category accent colors via CSS var on the card */
.v-card[data-cat="Pricing & Pay"]{--v-accent:var(--yellow2);}
.v-card[data-cat="Proposals & Tools"]{--v-accent:var(--teal2);}
.v-card[data-cat="Rep Workflows"]{--v-accent:var(--orange2);}
.v-card[data-cat="Operations"]{--v-accent:var(--green2);}
.v-card[data-cat="Aurora Solar"]{--v-accent:var(--teal3);}
.v-card[data-cat="Sunrun"]{--v-accent:var(--purple2);}

[data-theme="light"] .v-card{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07);border-color:var(--border2);}
[data-theme="light"] .v-card:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}

/* ════════════════════
   CONTACTS
════════════════════ */
.ccgrid{display:grid;gap:10px;grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-bottom:20px;}
@media(min-width:480px){.ccgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
@media(min-width:900px){.ccgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
.ct-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-radius:var(--rad-sm);overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);margin-bottom:16px;}
.ct-tab{flex:1;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);background:var(--bg3);border:none;transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;}
.ct-tab i{font-size:11px;transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .2s;}
.ct-tab:active{transform:scale(.95);}
.ct-tab[data-ct="lgcy"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(242,119,50,.5);}
.ct-tab[data-ct="lgcy"].active i{color:#fff;transform:scale(1.2);}
.ct-tab[data-ct="tools"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(44,142,155,.5);}
.ct-tab[data-ct="tools"].active i{color:#fff;transform:scale(1.2);}
.ct-tab:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--text2);transform:scale(1.02);}
.ct-panel{animation:fadeUp .15s ease;}
.cc{background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--rad);padding:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .18s;}
.cc:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
.cc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;}
.cc.or::before{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.cc.tl::before{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.cc.yl::before{background:var(--yellow-grd);}
.cc.gr::before{background:var(--green-grd);}
.cc-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:2px;}
.cc-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:10px;font-style:italic;line-height:1.4;}
.cc-row{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:5px;line-height:1.5;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
.cc-row a{color:var(--orange2);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.cc-row a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
.cc-hrs{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.8;}
.cc-hrs b{color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;}
.cc-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:10px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.06em;background:var(--orange-grd);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;}

/* ════════════════════
   BOTTOM NAV
════════════════════ */
.bnav{height:var(--bnav);display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--bg2);border-top:1.5px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);position:relative;}
.bnav::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--orange-grd);opacity:.35;}
.bnav-btn{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text3);transition:color .2s;position:relative;}
.bnav-btn i{font-size:18px;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
.bnav-btn.active i{transform:scale(1.18);}
.bnav-btn span{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;}
.bnav-btn[data-bnav="home"] i{color:var(--orange2);}
.bnav-btn[data-bnav="finance"] i{color:var(--teal2);}
.bnav-btn[data-bnav="avl"] i{color:var(--yellow2);}
.bnav-btn[data-bnav="contacts"] i{color:var(--green2);}
.bnav-btn.active{color:var(--orange2);}
.bnav-btn.active::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:15%;right:15%;height:2.5px;background:var(--orange-grd);border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;}

/* ════════════════════
   MOBILE OVERRIDES
   max-width: 600px
════════════════════ */
@media(max-width:600px){

  /* ── CSS vars ── */
  :root{--hdr:52px;--bnav:58px;}

  /* ── Header: compact, search pill takes full remaining width ── */
  .hdr{padding:0 12px;gap:8px;}
  .hdr-bolt{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:7px;}
  .hdr-bolt i{font-size:13px;}
  .hdr-name{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .hdr-name span{font-size:7.5px;}
  .hdr-div{display:none;}
  .srch-wrap{max-width:none;}
  #srch{padding:7px 10px 7px 28px;font-size:13px;}
  .theme-btn{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0;}

  /* ── Segment toggle: full width, equal thirds ── */
  .seg-wrap{padding:5px 10px;}
  .seg{display:flex;width:100%;}
  .seg-btn{padding:7px 6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;gap:5px;}
  .seg-btn i{font-size:10px;}

  /* ── Pane padding: tighter ── */
  .pane{padding:12px 12px 24px;}

  /* ── Hero banners: shorter ── */
  .hero{padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .hero-tag{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .hero p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;}
  .hero-bg-glyph{font-size:80px;right:-4px;bottom:-12px;}

  /* ── Quick access: 3 wide → 3 wide already, tighten ── */
  .qgrid{gap:7px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .qbtn{padding:11px 9px;gap:4px;}
  .qico{font-size:17px;}
  .qlbl{font-size:12px;}
  .qsub{font-size:9px;}

  /* ── Guide cards: single col, less padding ── */
  .cgrid{gap:7px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .gc{padding:12px 13px;gap:4px;}
  .gc-sec{font-size:10px;}
  .gc-title{font-size:14px;}
  .gc-desc{font-size:11.5px;}
  .gc-foot{margin-top:4px;}
  .garrow{opacity:.4;}

  /* ── Section labels ── */
  .slabel{font-size:11px;margin:14px 0 8px;}
  .v-section-label{margin:16px 0 7px;}

  /* ── Favourites ── */
  .fav-title{font-size:13px;}

  /* ── Finance cards ── */
  .fgrid{gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .fc{padding:14px;}
  .fc-name{font-size:17px;}
  .fc-desc{font-size:12px;}
  .fc-btn{font-size:12px;padding:6px 12px;}

  /* ── AVL section ── */
  .avl-cfg{padding:10px 11px;margin-bottom:10px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .avl-op-bar{gap:4px;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:8px;}
  .op-pill{font-size:10px;padding:4px 9px;}
  .cmp-pill{font-size:10px;padding:4px 10px;}
  .live-badge{font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;}
  .avl-tab{padding:8px 4px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;gap:3px;}
  .avl-tab i{font-size:9px;}
  .state-chip{font-size:9px;padding:3px 7px;}
  .state-filter-bar{gap:3px;margin-bottom:6px;padding-bottom:6px;}
  .avl-lf-btn{font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;}
  .avl-table th{font-size:10px;padding:7px 9px;}
  .avl-table td{font-size:11.5px;padding:7px 9px;}
  .avl-cfg-key{font-size:11px;}
  .avl-srch{font-size:12px;padding:6px 11px;}

  /* ── Contacts ── */
  .ct-tab{font-size:11px;padding:9px 6px;gap:4px;letter-spacing:.05em;}
  .ct-tab i{font-size:10px;}
  .cc{padding:13px;}
  .cc-title{font-size:13px;}
  .cc-sub{font-size:10.5px;}
  .cc-row{font-size:12px;}
  .cc-hrs{font-size:10.5px;}
  .cc-cta{font-size:12px;padding:5px 11px;}

  /* ── Video cards: single col on mobile ── */
  .v-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .v-play-side{width:42px;min-width:42px;}
  .v-play-circle{width:26px;height:26px;}
  .v-play-circle i{font-size:9px;}
  .v-info{padding:8px 10px;}
  .v-label{font-size:12px;}
  .v-badge{font-size:8px;padding:1px 5px;}

  /* ── Guide category bar: horizontal scroll on mobile ── */
  .guide-cat-bar{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding-bottom:4px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .guide-cat-bar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
  .gcat-btn{font-size:10px;padding:5px 10px;flex-shrink:0;}

  /* ── Video filter buttons: smaller, wrap nicely ── */
  .v-filter-bar{gap:4px;padding:6px 0 4px;}
  .v-filter-btn{font-size:10px;padding:4px 9px;gap:3px;}
  .v-filter-btn i{font-size:9px;}

  /* ── Bottom nav: bigger tap targets ── */
  .bnav{height:var(--bnav);}
  .bnav-btn i{font-size:20px;}
  .bnav-btn span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;}

  /* ── Viewer bar: compact ── */
  .viewer-bar{height:46px;padding:0 10px;gap:6px;}
  .vback{font-size:11px;padding:5px 10px;}
  .vtitle{font-size:13px;}
  .vext,.vshare{font-size:11px;padding:5px 9px;}

  /* ── Modals: full screen on mobile ── */
  .op-overlay,.cmp-overlay{padding:0;}
  .op-modal,.cmp-modal{max-width:100%;height:100vh;border-radius:0;max-height:100vh;}
  .op-modal-hdr,.cmp-modal-hdr{padding:12px 14px;}
  .op-modal-title,.cmp-modal-title{font-size:16px;}
  .cmp-hdr{padding:10px 12px;}
  .cmp-title{font-size:14px;}
  .cmp-tabs{padding:0 10px;}
  .cmp-tab{font-size:11px;padding:8px 10px;}
  .cmp-tbl thead tr th{font-size:10px;padding:8px 6px 6px;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .cmp-tbl thead tr th:first-child{min-width:72px;width:72px;}
  .cmp-tbl-lname{font-size:12px;}
  .cmp-tbl-lsub{font-size:8px;padding:1px 5px;}
  .cmp-tbl td{font-size:11px;padding:7px 6px;}
  .cmp-tbl td:first-child{font-size:9px;min-width:72px;width:72px;}

  /* ── Search overlay ── */
  .srch-ov{padding:12px;}
  .srch-ov-hdr{gap:8px;}

}

/* ── Extra small (≤380px) ── */
@media(max-width:380px){
  .hdr-name{font-size:13px;}
  .seg-btn{font-size:10px;padding:6px 4px;}
  .qgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .qlbl{font-size:11px;}
  .gc-title{font-size:13px;}
  .bnav-btn span{display:none;}
  .bnav-btn i{font-size:22px;}
  :root{--bnav:52px;}
}

/* ════════════════════
   GUIDE CATEGORY BAR
════════════════════ */
.guide-cat-bar{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.gcat-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  padding:5px 11px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;
  border:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text3);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);white-space:nowrap;
}
.gcat-btn i{font-size:9px;}
.gcat-btn:active{transform:scale(.95);}
.gcat-btn.active{border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="All"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Onboarding"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Finance"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Proposal Tools"].active{background:var(--yellow-grd);color:#211F1E!important;}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Aurora Solar"].active{background:var(--teal-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Pipeline"].active{background:var(--green-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Compensation"].active{background:var(--purple-grd);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Operations"].active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2C8E9B,#3DC0CC);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Technical"].active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4F5936,#828E3F);}
.gcat-btn[data-sec="Appointments"].active{background:var(--orange-grd);}
.gcat-btn:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--text2);}
/* Section group label inside guide grid */
.cgrid-section-label{
  grid-column:1/-1;
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:var(--text3);padding:4px 0 2px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:4px;
}
.cgrid-section-label:first-child{border-top:none;margin-top:0;}
.cgrid-section-label i{font-size:9px;}

/* ════════════════════
   ONE-PAGER MODAL
════════════════════ */
.op-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);z-index:300;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;}
.op-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.op-modal{width:100%;max-width:780px;height:88vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--rad);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7);animation:cmpIn .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
.op-modal-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;}
.op-modal-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.op-close{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;transition:border-color .15s;}
.op-close:hover{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange2);}
.op-modal-body{flex:1;overflow:hidden;}
.op-modal-body iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;}

/* ════════════════════
   COMPARE MODAL
════════════════════ */
.cmp-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);z-index:400;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;}
.cmp-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.cmp-modal{background:var(--bg2);width:100%;max-width:860px;max-height:88vh;border-radius:var(--rad);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7);animation:cmpIn .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);}
@keyframes cmpIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.94);}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}}
.cmp-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border2);flex-shrink:0;}
.cmp-title{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.05em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.cmp-close{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;transition:border-color .15s;}
.cmp-close:hover{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange2);}
.cmp-updated{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.cmp-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:none;flex-shrink:0;scrollbar-width:none;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--bg3);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.cmp-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.cmp-tab{
  padding:5px 13px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);
  font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:var(--text3);background:var(--bg2);
  border:1px solid var(--border2);
  cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;
  transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2),color .18s,box-shadow .18s,transform .12s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2);
}
.cmp-tab.active{
  background:var(--yellow-grd);color:#211F1E;
  border-color:transparent;
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(254,195,85,.45);
  transform:scale(1.04);
}
.cmp-tab:not(.active):hover{background:var(--bg4);color:var(--text2);transform:scale(1.02);}
.cmp-tab:active{transform:scale(.96);}
.cmp-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:60px;}
.cmp-tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
.cmp-tbl{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:420px;}
.cmp-tbl thead tr th{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--bg2);z-index:2;padding:10px 10px 8px;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text3);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border2);text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;}
.cmp-tbl thead tr th:first-child{text-align:left;min-width:90px;width:90px;position:sticky;left:0;background:var(--bg2);z-index:3;}
.cmp-tbl-lhdr{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;}
.cmp-tbl-lname{font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.cmp-tbl-lsub{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:20px;}
.cmp-tbl-lsub.tpo{background:rgba(112,80,184,.15);color:var(--purple2);}
.cmp-tbl-lsub.loan{background:rgba(130,142,63,.15);color:var(--green2);}
.cmp-tbl-lsub.ppa{background:rgba(44,142,155,.15);color:var(--teal2);}
.cmp-tbl td{padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle;text-align:center;color:var(--text2);}
.cmp-tbl td:first-child{text-align:left;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--text3);background:var(--bg2);position:sticky;left:0;z-index:1;}
.cmp-tbl tr:last-child td{border:none;}
.cmp-tbl tr:hover td{background:var(--bg4);}
.cmp-tbl tr:hover td:first-child{background:var(--bg3);}
.cmp-yes{color:var(--green2);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;}
.cmp-no{color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;}
.cmp-warn{color:var(--yellow2);font-weight:700;}
.cmp-badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;}
.cmp-badge.good{background:rgba(130,142,63,.15);color:var(--green2);border:1px solid rgba(130,142,63,.3);}
.cmp-badge.warn{background:rgba(254,195,85,.12);color:var(--yellow2);border:1px solid rgba(254,195,85,.3);}
.cmp-badge.no{background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);color:var(--text3);border:1px solid var(--border);}
.cmp-section-row td{background:var(--bg3)!important;font-family:'Sequel100Black75',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--text3);padding:5px 10px!important;}
.cmp-onepager-btn{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:var(--rad-pill);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.cmp-onepager-btn:hover{border-color:var(--yellow2);color:var(--yellow2);}

/* battery live tag inside compare */

/* ════════════════════

════════════════════ */
.spinner{text-align:center;padding:30px;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;}
.err-box{padding:12px;background:rgba(255,80,80,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,80,.2);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);font-size:12.5px;color:#ff8080;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.fav-empty{padding:12px;text-align:center;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--rad-sm);border:1px dashed var(--border2);}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
.fa-spin{animation:spin 1s linear infinite;}
@keyframes starPop{0%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.45);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}
.star-pop{animation:starPop .22s ease;}
</style>

/* ═══════════ STATE ═══════════ */
var currentPane = 'home', currentMode = 'guides', prevPane = 'home';
var avlLoaded = false, avlFinanceData = null, avlEquipData = null;
var avlActiveLender = 'all', avlActiveState = 'all';
var adderLoaded = false, adderData = [], adderActiveFilter = 'all';

/* ═══════════ THEME ═══════════ */
function toggleTheme(){
  var light = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')==='light';
  var next = light ? '' : 'light';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
  document.getElementById('theme-ico').className = next==='light' ? 'fa-solid fa-moon' : 'fa-solid fa-sun';
  try{localStorage.setItem('lgcy-theme', next);}catch(e){}
}
(function(){
  try{
    var t = localStorage.getItem('lgcy-theme');
    if(t==='light'){
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','light');
      var ico=document.getElementById('theme-ico');
      if(ico) ico.className='fa-solid fa-moon';
    }
  }catch(e){}
})();

/* ═══════════ PANE SWITCHING ═══════════ */
function switchPane(name, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(name==='sheets'){switchMode('sheets');return;}
  if(name==='videos'){switchMode('videos');return;}
  prevPane=currentPane;
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active');});
  var pane=document.getElementById('pane-'+name);
  var viewer=document.getElementById('pane-viewer');
  if(viewer) viewer.classList.remove('active');
  if(pane) pane.classList.add('active');
  currentPane=name;
  var sw=document.getElementById('seg-wrap');
  if(sw) sw.style.display=(name==='home'||name==='sheets'||name==='videos')?'':'none';
  if(name==='home') document.querySelectorAll('.seg-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mode==='guides');});
  document.querySelectorAll('.bnav-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.bnav===name);});
  if(pane) pane.scrollTop=0;
  if(name==='avl'&&!avlLoaded) loadAVL();
  if(name==='avl'&&opts.adderTab) setTimeout(function(){var t=document.querySelector('.avl-tab[data-avltab="adders"]');if(t)t.click();},80);
}
window.switchPane=switchPane;

function switchMode(mode){
  currentMode=mode;
  var sw=document.getElementById('seg-wrap');
  if(sw) sw.style.display='';
  document.querySelectorAll('.seg-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mode===mode);});
  var targets={guides:'home',sheets:'sheets',videos:'videos'};
  var target=targets[mode]||'home';
  prevPane=currentPane;
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active');});
  var viewer=document.getElementById('pane-viewer');
  if(viewer) viewer.classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('pane-'+target).classList.add('active');
  currentPane=target;
  document.querySelectorAll('.bnav-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.bnav===target);});
  if(mode==='videos') renderVideos();
}

/* ═══════════ GUIDE VIEWER ═══════════ */
function openGuide(url, title){
  if(!url) return;
  prevPane=currentPane;
  document.getElementById('vtitle').textContent=title||'Guide';
  document.getElementById('vext').href=url;
  document.getElementById('gframe').src=url;
  var vshare=document.getElementById('vshare');
  if(vshare){vshare.dataset.url=url;vshare.dataset.title=title||'';}
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active');});
  document.getElementById('pane-viewer').classList.add('active');
  currentPane='viewer';
  try{
    var recent=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lgcy-recent')||'[]');
    recent=recent.filter(function(r){return r.url!==url;});
    recent.unshift({url:url,label:title,ts:Date.now()});
    localStorage.setItem('lgcy-recent',JSON.stringify(recent.slice(0,8)));
  }catch(e){}
}
window.openGuide=openGuide;

/* ═══════════ FAVORITES ═══════════ */
function getFavs(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lgcy-favs')||'[]');}catch(e){return[];}}
function saveFavs(a){try{localStorage.setItem('lgcy-favs',JSON.stringify(a));}catch(e){}}
function isFav(id){return getFavs().indexOf(id)>-1;}
function toggleFav(id){
  var f=getFavs();var i=f.indexOf(id);
  if(i>-1)f.splice(i,1);else f.push(id);
  saveFavs(f);renderFavs();renderAllGuides();
}
function renderFavs(){
  var favs=getFavs();
  var sec=document.getElementById('fav-section');
  var grid=document.getElementById('fav-grid');
  if(!sec||!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML='';
  if(!favs.length){sec.style.display='none';return;}
  sec.style.display='block';
  favs.forEach(function(id){
    var g=GUIDES.find(function(x){return x.id===id;});
    if(!g||!g.url) return;
    var card=document.createElement('div');card.className='fav-card';
    card.innerHTML='<div class="fav-ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-star" style="color:var(--yellow2);"></i></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:0;"><div class="fav-title">'+g.label+'</div><div class="fav-sec">'+g.section+'</div></div><button class="fav-rm"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>';
    card.querySelector('div[style]').addEventListener('click',function(){openGuide(g.url,g.label);});
    card.querySelector('.fav-rm').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();toggleFav(id);});
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

/* ═══════════ GUIDE CARDS ═══════════ */
function makeGuideCard(g, hl){
  var dis=!g.url;
  function h(s){if(!hl)return s;return s.replace(new RegExp('('+hl.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')+')','gi'),'<mark>$1</mark>');}
  var starred=isFav(g.id);
  var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='gc'+(dis?' dis':'');
  d.innerHTML=(!dis?'<button class="gc-star'+(starred?' starred':'')+'" data-id="'+g.id+'" title="Favorite"><i class="fa-'+(starred?'solid':'regular')+' fa-star"></i></button>':'')+
    '<div class="gc-sec">'+h(g.section)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="gc-title">'+h(g.label)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="gc-desc">'+h(g.desc)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="gc-foot"><span class="gbadge'+(dis?' soon':'')+'">'+(g.badge)+'</span>'+(!dis?'<i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right garrow"></i>':'')+'</div>';
  if(!dis){
    d.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target.closest('.gc-star'))return;openGuide(g.url,g.label);});
    var star=d.querySelector('.gc-star');
    if(star) star.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();star.classList.add('star-pop');
      star.addEventListener('animationend',function(){star.classList.remove('star-pop');},{once:true});
      toggleFav(g.id);
    });
  }
  return d;
}
var _activeGuideSection = 'All';

function renderGuideCatBar(){
  var bar = document.getElementById('guide-cat-bar'); if(!bar) return;
  // Derive unique sections directly from GUIDES data in order
  var seen = {}, sections = ['All'];
  GUIDES.forEach(function(g){ if(!seen[g.section]){seen[g.section]=1;sections.push(g.section);} });
  var icons = {
    'All':'fa-border-all',
    'Onboarding':'fa-id-card',
    'Finance':'fa-hand-holding-dollar',
    'Proposal Tools':'fa-file-invoice',
    'Aurora Solar':'fa-solar-panel',
    'Pipeline':'fa-chart-gantt',
    'Compensation':'fa-money-bill-wave',
    'Operations':'fa-gears',
    'Technical':'fa-screwdriver-wrench',
    'Appointments':'fa-calendar-check'
  };
  bar.innerHTML = sections.map(function(sec){
    var ico = icons[sec]||'fa-book-open';
    var active = sec===_activeGuideSection?' active':'';
    return '<button class="gcat-btn'+active+'" data-sec="'+sec+'"><i class="fa-solid '+ico+'"></i> '+sec+'</button>';
  }).join('');
  bar.querySelectorAll('.gcat-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      _activeGuideSection = btn.dataset.sec;
      renderGuideCatBar();
      renderAllGuides();
    });
  });
}

function renderAllGuides(query){
  var grid=document.getElementById('all-grid');if(!grid)return;grid.innerHTML='';
  var q=(query||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  var list=q?GUIDES.filter(function(g){return(g.label+g.desc+g.kw+g.section).toLowerCase().includes(q);}):GUIDES;
  if(_activeGuideSection!=='All'&&!q){
    list=list.filter(function(g){return g.section===_activeGuideSection;});
  }
  if(q||_activeGuideSection!=='All'){
    // flat list when filtered
    list.forEach(function(g){grid.appendChild(makeGuideCard(g,q));});
  } else {
    // grouped by section when showing All
    var sectionOrder=[],secSeen={};
    GUIDES.forEach(function(g){if(!secSeen[g.section]){secSeen[g.section]=1;sectionOrder.push(g.section);}});
    var sectionIcons={'Onboarding':'fa-id-card','Finance':'fa-hand-holding-dollar','Proposal Tools':'fa-file-invoice','Aurora Solar':'fa-solar-panel','Pipeline':'fa-chart-gantt','Compensation':'fa-money-bill-wave','Operations':'fa-gears','Technical':'fa-screwdriver-wrench','Appointments':'fa-calendar-check'};
    sectionOrder.forEach(function(sec){
      var sectionGuides=list.filter(function(g){return g.section===sec;});
      if(!sectionGuides.length) return;
      var lbl=document.createElement('div');
      lbl.className='cgrid-section-label';
      lbl.innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid '+(sectionIcons[sec]||'fa-folder')+'"></i>'+sec;
      grid.appendChild(lbl);
      sectionGuides.forEach(function(g){grid.appendChild(makeGuideCard(g,q));});
    });
  }
}

/* ═══════════ SIDEBAR ═══════════ */
function renderSidebar(){
  var scroll=document.getElementById('sb-scroll');if(!scroll)return;
  var html='';
  SIDEBAR_SECTIONS.forEach(function(sec){
    html+='<div class="ns"><button class="ns-btn"><div class="ns-left"><i class="fa-solid '+sec.ico+'" style="font-size:9px;opacity:.65;"></i><span>'+sec.label+'</span></div><span class="ns-arrow"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right" style="font-size:9px;"></i></span></button><div class="ns-body">';
    sec.items.forEach(function(item){
      var dis=!item.url;var chipCls=item.chip==='Soon'?' soon':'';
      html+='<button class="nl'+(dis?' dis':'')+'"'+(item.url?' data-url="'+item.url+'"':'')+' ><span class="nl-txt">'+item.label+'</span><span class="chip'+chipCls+'">'+item.chip+'</span></button>';
    });
    html+='</div></div>';
  });
  scroll.innerHTML=html;
  scroll.querySelectorAll('.ns-btn').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){btn.closest('.ns').classList.toggle('open');});});
  scroll.querySelectorAll('.nl:not(.dis)').forEach(function(btn){
    if(btn.dataset.url) btn.addEventListener('click',function(){openGuide(btn.dataset.url,btn.querySelector('.nl-txt').textContent);});
  });
}

/* ═══════════ VIDEOS ═══════════ */
var VIDEO_CAT_ICONS={'Pricing & Pay':'fa-dollar-sign','Proposals & Tools':'fa-file-invoice-dollar','Rep Workflows':'fa-list-check','Operations':'fa-gears','Aurora Solar':'fa-solar-panel','Sunrun':'fa-sun'};
var _vActiveFilter='All';

function renderVideos(){
  var el=document.getElementById('videos-content');if(!el)return;
  var cats=['All'],bycat={};
  VIDEOS.forEach(function(v){if(!bycat[v.category]){bycat[v.category]=[];cats.push(v.category);}bycat[v.category].push(v);});
  var filterHtml='<div class="v-filter-bar">';
  cats.forEach(function(cat){
    var ico=cat==='All'?'fa-border-all':(VIDEO_CAT_ICONS[cat]||'fa-video');
    var cnt=cat==='All'?VIDEOS.length:bycat[cat].length;
    filterHtml+='<button class="v-filter-btn'+(cat===_vActiveFilter?' active':'')+'" data-cat="'+cat+'"><i class="fa-solid '+ico+'"></i> '+cat+' <span style="opacity:.5;font-size:9px;">('+cnt+')</span></button>';
  });
  filterHtml+='</div><div id="v-grid-wrap"></div>';
  el.innerHTML=filterHtml;
  el.querySelectorAll('.v-filter-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      _vActiveFilter=btn.dataset.cat;
      el.querySelectorAll('.v-filter-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.cat===_vActiveFilter);});
      buildVideoGrid();
    });
  });
  buildVideoGrid();
}

function buildVideoGrid(){
  var wrap=document.getElementById('v-grid-wrap');if(!wrap)return;wrap.innerHTML='';
  var bycat={},catOrder=[];
  VIDEOS.forEach(function(v){if(!bycat[v.category]){bycat[v.category]=[];catOrder.push(v.category);}bycat[v.category].push(v);});
  var toRender=_vActiveFilter==='All'?catOrder:[_vActiveFilter];
  toRender.forEach(function(cat){
    var vids=bycat[cat];if(!vids)return;
    if(_vActiveFilter==='All'){
      var lbl=document.createElement('div');lbl.className='v-section-label';
      var ico=VIDEO_CAT_ICONS[cat]||'fa-video';
      lbl.innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid '+ico+'"></i>'+cat+'<span style="font-weight:500;opacity:.4;font-size:10px;margin-left:3px;">'+vids.length+'</span>';
      wrap.appendChild(lbl);
    }
    var grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='v-grid';
    vids.forEach(function(v){
      var card=document.createElement('div');card.className='v-card';card.dataset.cat=v.category;
      var playSide=document.createElement('div');playSide.className='v-play-side';
      playSide.innerHTML='<div class="v-play-circle"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></div>';
      var info=document.createElement('div');info.className='v-info';
      var ico=VIDEO_CAT_ICONS[v.category]||'fa-video';
      info.innerHTML='<div class="v-label">'+v.label+'</div><span class="v-badge"><i class="fa-solid '+ico+'"></i> '+v.category+'</span>';
      card.appendChild(playSide);card.appendChild(info);
      card.addEventListener('click',function(){openGuide('https://www.loom.com/embed/'+v.loom+'?hide_owner=true&hide_share=true&hideEmbedTopBar=true',v.label);});
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(grid);
  });
}
