var cmpActiveTab='eligibility';

function renderCompareBody(){
  var upd=document.getElementById('cmp-updated');
  // Show live data status
  var liveTxt=avlLoaded?'<span class="live-dot" style="display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green2);box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--green2);margin-right:4px;"></span>Live data':'Updated March 2026';
  if(upd) upd.innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> '+liveTxt;
  var TABS=[{id:'eligibility',label:'Eligibility'},{id:'products',label:'Products & Tools'},{id:'loan',label:'Loan Details'},{id:'property',label:'Property Types'},{id:'battery',label:'Battery'},{id:'restrictions',label:'Restrictions'}];
  var tabsEl=document.getElementById('cmp-tabs');
  tabsEl.innerHTML=TABS.map(function(t){return'<button class="cmp-tab'+(t.id===cmpActiveTab?' active':'')+'" data-cid="'+t.id+'">'+t.label+'</button>';}).join('');
  tabsEl.querySelectorAll('.cmp-tab').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){cmpActiveTab=btn.dataset.cid;renderCompareTab();tabsEl.querySelectorAll('.cmp-tab').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.cid===cmpActiveTab);});});
  });
  renderCompareTab();
}

function renderCompareTab(){
  var el=document.getElementById('cmp-body');
  var COLS=[{id:'gl-loan',opKey:'s2'},{id:'gl-tpo',opKey:'s1'},{id:'eb',opKey:'s3'},{id:'sr',opKey:'s4'},{id:'en',opKey:'s5'},{id:'sg',opKey:'s6'},{id:'propel',opKey:'s7'}];
  function lender(id){return LENDER_STATIC.find(function(l){return l.id===id;})||{};}
  function subClass(sub){if(!sub)return'';var s=sub.toLowerCase();if(s.indexOf('loan')>-1)return'loan';if(s.indexOf('tpo')>-1||s.indexOf('ppa')>-1||s.indexOf('lease')>-1)return'tpo';return'ppa';}
  function cell(val,type){
    if(!val)return'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';type=type||'text';
    if(type==='bool'){if(val.indexOf('✓')>-1)return'<span class="cmp-yes">✓</span>';if(val.indexOf('✗')>-1)return'<span class="cmp-no">✗</span>';}
    if(type==='credit')return'<span class="cmp-badge '+(val.indexOf('640')>-1?'warn':'good')+'">'+val+'</span>';
    if(type==='warn-flag'){var clean=val.replace('✓','').replace('✗','').trim();if(val.indexOf('✓')>-1)return'<span class="cmp-badge good">✓ '+clean+'</span>';if(val.indexOf('✗')>-1)return'<span class="cmp-badge no">✗ '+clean+'</span>';return'<span class="cmp-warn">'+clean+'</span>';}
    return'<span>'+val+'</span>';
  }
  function buildHeader(){
    var h='<thead><tr><th></th>';
    COLS.forEach(function(c){
      var L=lender(c.id);
      h+='<th><div class="cmp-tbl-lhdr"><div class="cmp-tbl-lname" style="color:'+(L.accent||'var(--yellow2)')+'">'+L.name+'</div><div class="cmp-tbl-lsub '+subClass(L.sub)+'">'+L.sub+'</div></div></th>';
    });
    return h+'</tr></thead>';
  }
  function row(label,fn){var r='<tr><td>'+label+'</td>';COLS.forEach(function(c){r+='<td>'+fn(lender(c.id))+'</td>';});return r+'</tr>';}
  function secRow(label){return'<tr class="cmp-section-row"><td colspan="'+(COLS.length+1)+'">'+label+'</td></tr>';}
  var body='';

  if(cmpActiveTab==='eligibility'){
    body='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Credit');
    body+=row('Min FICO',function(L){return cell(L.credit,'credit');});
    body+=row('Bureau',function(L){return cell(L.bureau);});
    body+=secRow('Application');
    body+=row('Co-Applicant',function(L){return cell(L.coapp);});
    body+=row('Down Payment',function(L){return cell(L.downpay,'bool');});
    body+=row('LLC / Trust',function(L){return cell(L.llcTrust);});
    body+=row('Languages',function(L){return cell(L.lang);});
    body+=secRow('Notes');
    body+=row('Rep Notes',function(L){return L.notes?'<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);">'+L.notes+'</span>':'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';

  }else if(cmpActiveTab==='products'){
    body='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Proposal Tools');body+=row('Tools',function(L){return cell(L.tools);});
    body+=secRow('Product');body+=row('Transfer',function(L){return cell(L.transfer,'warn-flag');});body+=row('Add-Ons',function(L){return cell(L.addons,'warn-flag');});
    body+=secRow('System');body+=row('Size',function(L){return cell(L.systemSize);});body+=row('Min Loan',function(L){return cell(L.minLoan);});body+=row('Max Loan',function(L){return cell(L.maxLoan);});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';

  }else if(cmpActiveTab==='loan'){
    body='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Loan Size');body+=row('Min Loan',function(L){return cell(L.minLoan);});body+=row('Max Loan',function(L){return cell(L.maxLoan);});
    body+=secRow('Terms');body+=row('Transfer',function(L){return cell(L.transfer,'warn-flag');});body+=row('Down Payment',function(L){return cell(L.downpay,'bool');});body+=row('Co-Applicant',function(L){return cell(L.coapp);});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';

  }else if(cmpActiveTab==='property'){
    body='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Property Types');body+=row('Approved',function(L){return L.properties?'<span style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;">'+L.properties+'</span>':'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';});
    body+=secRow('System');body+=row('Size',function(L){return cell(L.systemSize);});body+=row('Add-Ons',function(L){return cell(L.addons,'warn-flag');});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';

  }else if(cmpActiveTab==='battery'){
    // Battery tab with live data indicator
    var liveNote=avlLoaded?'<span class="cmp-bat-live"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle" style="font-size:6px;"></i> Live</span>':'';
    body='<div style="padding:10px 16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-solar-panel" style="color:var(--yellow2);"></i> Battery data pulled from live AVL sheet '+liveNote+'</div>';
    body+='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Battery Compatibility');
    // Pull battery from live data if available, else fall back to static
    body+=row('Approved Batteries',function(L){
      var batText=L.battery;
      // If live equip data is available, try to find battery info
      if(avlEquipData){
        var lenderName=L.name;
        var matches=[];
        avlEquipData.forEach(function(sec){
          if(sec.lender.toLowerCase()===lenderName.toLowerCase()){
            sec.configs.forEach(function(cfg){if(cfg.battery)matches.push(cfg.battery);});
          }
        });
        var unique=[],seen={};
        matches.forEach(function(m){if(!seen[m]){seen[m]=true;unique.push(m);}});
        if(unique.length>0) batText=unique.join(', ');
      }
      return batText?'<span style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;">'+batText+'</span>':'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';
    });
    body+=secRow('Add-Ons');body+=row('Add-On Approval',function(L){return cell(L.addons,'warn-flag');});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';

  }else if(cmpActiveTab==='restrictions'){
    body='<div class="cmp-tbl-wrap"><table class="cmp-tbl">'+buildHeader()+'<tbody>';
    body+=secRow('Roof Restrictions');body+=row('Roof Restrictions',function(L){return L.roofNot?'<span style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text2);">'+L.roofNot+'</span>':'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';});
    body+=secRow('Notes');body+=row('Rep Notes',function(L){return L.notes?'<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);">'+L.notes+'</span>':'<span class="cmp-no">—</span>';});
    body+='</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  el.innerHTML=body;
}

/* ═══════════ SEARCH ═══════════ */
var ALL_SEARCHABLE=GUIDES.map(function(g){return{id:g.id,type:'guide',label:g.label,section:g.section,badge:g.badge,kw:(g.label+' '+g.desc+' '+g.kw+' '+g.section).toLowerCase(),url:g.url};})
  .concat(VIDEOS.map(function(v){return{id:v.id,type:'video',label:v.label,section:v.category,badge:'Video',kw:(v.label+' '+v.category).toLowerCase(),loom:v.loom};}));

function openSearch(){
  document.getElementById('srch-overlay').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(function(){document.getElementById('srch-ov-input').focus();},50);
  renderSearchResults('');
}
function closeSearch(){document.getElementById('srch-overlay').classList.remove('open');}
function renderSearchResults(q){
  var el=document.getElementById('srch-ov-results');if(!el)return;
  if(!q||q.length<2){el.innerHTML='<div class="srch-empty"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" style="font-size:28px;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:.3;"></i>Search guides and videos</div>';return;}
  var ql=q.toLowerCase();
  var matches=ALL_SEARCHABLE.filter(function(i){return i.kw.includes(ql);});
  if(!matches.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="srch-empty">No results for "<strong>'+q+'</strong>"</div>';return;}
  var groups={guides:[],videos:[]};
  matches.forEach(function(i){if(i.type==='video')groups.videos.push(i);else groups.guides.push(i);});
  var html='';
  if(groups.guides.length){
    html+='<div class="srch-sec">Guides ('+groups.guides.length+')</div>';
    groups.guides.forEach(function(i){html+='<div class="srch-item" data-id="'+i.id+'" data-type="guide"><div class="srch-ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-book-open" style="color:var(--teal2);"></i></div><div><div class="srch-label">'+i.label+'</div><div class="srch-sub">'+i.section+' · '+i.badge+'</div></div></div>';});
  }
  if(groups.videos.length){
    html+='<div class="srch-sec">Videos ('+groups.videos.length+')</div>';
    groups.videos.forEach(function(i){html+='<div class="srch-item" data-id="'+i.id+'" data-type="video"><div class="srch-ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-play" style="color:var(--purple2);"></i></div><div><div class="srch-label">'+i.label+'</div><div class="srch-sub">'+i.section+'</div></div></div>';});
  }
  el.innerHTML=html;
  el.querySelectorAll('.srch-item').forEach(function(item){
    item.addEventListener('click',function(){
      closeSearch();
      if(item.dataset.type==='video'){var v=VIDEOS.find(function(x){return x.id===item.dataset.id;});if(v)openGuide('https://www.loom.com/embed/'+v.loom+'?hide_owner=true&hide_share=true&hideEmbedTopBar=true',v.label);}
      else{var g=GUIDES.find(function(x){return x.id===item.dataset.id;});if(g&&g.url)openGuide(g.url,g.label);}
    });
  });
}

/* ═══════════ AVL FINANCE ═══════════ */
function parseCSV(text){
  var lines=text.split(/\r?\n/);
  return lines.map(function(line){
    var result=[],cur='',inQ=false;
    for(var i=0;i<line.length;i++){var c=line[i];if(c==='"'){inQ=!inQ;}else if(c===','&&!inQ){result.push(cur.trim());cur='';}else{cur+=c;}}
    result.push(cur.trim());return result;
  });
}

function loadAVL(){
  var loading=document.getElementById('avl-loading');
  var errEl=document.getElementById('avl-error');
  var today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  var cFinKey='lgcy-avl-finance-'+today, cEqKey='lgcy-avl-equip-'+today;
  try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if((k.startsWith('lgcy-avl-finance-')||k.startsWith('lgcy-avl-equip-'))&&k!==cFinKey&&k!==cEqKey)localStorage.removeItem(k);});}catch(e){}
  function applyData(finCsv,eqCsv,fromCache){
    if(loading) loading.style.display='none';
    avlFinanceData=parseFinanceData(finCsv);
    avlEquipData=parseEquipData(eqCsv);
    renderFinanceTable(avlFinanceData,'');
    renderEquipCards(avlEquipData,'all','all','');
    avlLoaded=true;
    var badge=document.getElementById('avl-live-badge');
    var meta=document.getElementById('avl-finance-meta');
    if(badge) badge.innerHTML=fromCache
      ?'<span class="live-badge cached"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt" style="font-size:9px;"></i> Cached today</span>'
      :'<span class="live-badge"><span class="live-dot"></span> Live Data · '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})+'</span>';
    if(meta) meta.style.display='flex';
  }
  try{
    var cF=localStorage.getItem(cFinKey),cE=localStorage.getItem(cEqKey);
    if(cF&&cE){applyData(cF,cE,true);return;}
  }catch(e){}
  if(loading) loading.style.display='block';
  if(errEl) errEl.style.display='none';
  Promise.all([fetch(AVL_FINANCE_URL).then(function(r){return r.text();}),fetch(AVL_EQUIP_URL).then(function(r){return r.text();})]).then(function(res){
    try{localStorage.setItem(cFinKey,res[0]);localStorage.setItem(cEqKey,res[1]);}catch(e){}
    applyData(res[0],res[1],false);
  }).catch(function(){
    if(loading) loading.style.display='none';
    if(errEl){errEl.style.display='flex';document.getElementById('avl-error-msg').textContent='Failed to load AVL data. Check your connection.';}
  });
}

function parseFinanceData(csv){
  var rows = parseCSV(csv);
  var stateMap = {};
  var headers = rows[1];
  var lenderCols = [];
for(var c = 1; c < headers.length; c++){
    var h = (headers[c]||'').trim();
    if(!h) continue;
    var parts = h.split(' ');
    var product = parts.pop();
    var lender = parts.length ? parts.join(' ') : product;
    lenderCols.push({ label:product, col:c, lender:lender });
  }
  for(var r = 2; r < rows.length; r++){
    var row = rows[r];
    var state = (row[0]||'').trim();
    if(!state) continue;
    stateMap[state] = {};
    lenderCols.forEach(function(lc){
      var val = (row[lc.col]||'').trim().toUpperCase();
      if(val === 'YES'){
        if(!stateMap[state][lc.lender]) stateMap[state][lc.lender] = {};
        stateMap[state][lc.lender][lc.label] = true;
      }
    });
  }
  var sorted = {};
  Object.keys(stateMap).sort().forEach(function(s){ sorted[s] = stateMap[s]; });
  var lenders = [];
  lenderCols.forEach(function(lc){ if(lenders.indexOf(lc.lender)===-1) lenders.push(lc.lender); });
  return { stateMap: sorted, lenders: lenders };
}

function renderFinanceTable(data,query){
  var container=document.getElementById('avl-finance-content');if(!container||!data)return;
  var q=query.toLowerCase().trim();
  var states=Object.keys(data.stateMap).sort();
  if(q) states=states.filter(function(s){return s.toLowerCase().includes(q)||Object.keys(data.stateMap[s]).some(function(l){return l.toLowerCase().includes(q);});});
  if(!states.length){container.innerHTML='<div class="avl-no-results">No results for "'+query+'"</div>';return;}
  var lenders=data.lenders;
  var html='<div class="avl-table-outer"><table class="avl-table"><thead><tr><th>State</th>';
  lenders.forEach(function(l){html+='<th>'+l+'</th>';});
  html+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
  states.forEach(function(state){
    html+='<tr><td><strong>'+state+'</strong></td>';
    lenders.forEach(function(l){
      var ld=data.stateMap[state][l];
      if(!ld){html+='<td><span class="avl-no-mark">—</span></td>';return;}
      var types=Object.keys(ld).filter(function(k){return ld[k];});
      if(!types.length){html+='<td><span class="avl-no-mark">✗</span></td>';return;}
      html+='<td>'+types.map(function(t){return'<span class="avl-yes">'+t+'</span>';}).join('')+'</td>';
    });
    html+='</tr>';
  });
  html+='</tbody></table></div>';
  container.innerHTML=html;
}

/* ═══════════ AVL EQUIPMENT ═══════════ */
function parseEquipData(csv){
  var rows=parseCSV(csv);
  var sections=[],current=null;
  for(var r=0;r<rows.length;r++){
    var row=rows[r];
    if(!row||row.every(function(c){return!c;})) continue;
    // Detect lender header row: col1='Option', col2 has lender name (not 'Loan/Cash')
    if((row[1]||'').trim()==='Option' && row[2] && !row[2].toLowerCase().includes('loan')){
      var nm=row[2].replace(/\s*TPO\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*Loan\/Cash\s*/i,'').trim();
      current={lender:nm,configs:[]};
      sections.push(current);
      continue;
    }
    if(!current) continue;
    // Data row: col1 is a number
    if(row[1]&&!isNaN(parseInt(row[1]))){
      // Left side — TPO config
      if((row[2]||'').trim()){
        current.configs.push({
          type:'TPO',
          market:(row[2]||'').trim(),
          config:(row[3]||'').trim(),
          battery:(row[4]||'').trim(),
          inverter:(row[5]||'').trim(),
          panels:(row[6]||'').trim()
        });
      }
      // Right side — Loan/Cash config
      if((row[8]||'').trim()){
        current.configs.push({
          type:'Loan/Cash',
          market:(row[8]||'').trim(),
          config:(row[9]||'').trim(),
          battery:(row[10]||'').trim(),
          inverter:(row[11]||'').trim(),
          panels:(row[12]||'').trim()
        });
      }
    // Continuation row (no number in col1) — right side only
    } else if(!(row[1]||'').trim() && (row[8]||'').trim() && r>4){
      current.configs.push({
        type:'Loan/Cash',
        market:(row[8]||'').trim(),
        config:(row[9]||'').trim(),
        battery:(row[10]||'').trim(),
        inverter:(row[11]||'').trim(),
        panels:(row[12]||'').trim()
      });
    }
  }
  return sections;
}
function buildStateFilterBar(data){
  var barEl=document.getElementById('avl-state-filter');
  if(!barEl) return;
  // Gather all unique states/markets
  var seen={}, states=[];
  data.forEach(function(sec){sec.configs.forEach(function(cfg){if(cfg.market&&!seen[cfg.market]){seen[cfg.market]=true;states.push(cfg.market);}});});
  if(states.length===0){barEl.style.display='none';return;}
  states.sort();
  barEl.style.display='flex';
  barEl.innerHTML='';
  var allChip=document.createElement('button');allChip.className='state-chip'+(avlActiveState==='all'?' active':'');allChip.textContent='All States';
  allChip.addEventListener('click',function(){avlActiveState='all';barEl.querySelectorAll('.state-chip').forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('active');});allChip.classList.add('active');renderEquipCards(avlEquipData,avlActiveLender,'all',document.getElementById('avl-srch-equip').value);});
  barEl.appendChild(allChip);
  states.forEach(function(s){
    var chip=document.createElement('button');chip.className='state-chip'+(avlActiveState===s?' active':'');chip.textContent=s;
    chip.addEventListener('click',function(){
      avlActiveState=s;barEl.querySelectorAll('.state-chip').forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('active');});chip.classList.add('active');
      renderEquipCards(avlEquipData,avlActiveLender,s,document.getElementById('avl-srch-equip').value);
    });
    barEl.appendChild(chip);
  });
}

function renderEquipCards(data,lenderFilter,stateFilter,query){
  var container=document.getElementById('avl-equip-content');if(!container||!data)return;
  var q=(query||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  var lf=lenderFilter||avlActiveLender;
  var sf=stateFilter||avlActiveState;

  // Build lender filter buttons
  var lfEl=document.getElementById('avl-lf2');
  if(lfEl&&lfEl.children.length===0){
    var lnames=['all'].concat(data.map(function(s){return s.lender;}).filter(function(l,i,a){return a.indexOf(l)===i;}));
    lnames.forEach(function(l){
      var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='avl-lf-btn'+(l===lf?' active':'');btn.textContent=l==='all'?'All':l;
      btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
        avlActiveLender=l;lfEl.querySelectorAll('.avl-lf-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn);});
        renderEquipCards(avlEquipData,l,avlActiveState,document.getElementById('avl-srch-equip').value);
      });
      lfEl.appendChild(btn);
    });
    buildStateFilterBar(data);
  }

  var sections=lf==='all'?data:data.filter(function(s){return s.lender===lf;});
  var html='',total=0;
  sections.forEach(function(section){
    var configs=section.configs;
    if(sf!=='all') configs=configs.filter(function(c){return c.market===sf;});
    if(q) configs=configs.filter(function(c){return[c.market,c.config,c.battery,c.inverter,c.panels].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q);});
    if(!configs.length) return;
    total+=configs.length;
    html+='<div class="avl-lender-section"><div class="avl-lender-title">'+section.lender+'</div><div class="avl-config-cards">';
    configs.forEach(function(cfg){
      var tp=cfg.type==='TPO'?'tpo':'loan';
      html+='<div class="avl-cfg"><span class="avl-cfg-type '+tp+'">'+cfg.type+'</span>';
      html+='<div class="avl-cfg-market"><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot" style="font-size:10px;margin-right:3px;color:var(--orange2);"></i>'+cfg.market+'</div>';
      html+='<div class="avl-cfg-config">'+(cfg.config||'Standard Config')+'</div>';
      html+='<div class="avl-cfg-rows">';
      if(cfg.battery) html+='<div class="avl-cfg-row"><span class="avl-cfg-key"><i class="fa-solid fa-battery-full" style="font-size:9px;margin-right:3px;"></i>Battery</span><span class="avl-cfg-val">'+cfg.battery+'</span></div>';
      if(cfg.inverter) html+='<div class="avl-cfg-row"><span class="avl-cfg-key"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt" style="font-size:9px;margin-right:3px;"></i>Inverter</span><span class="avl-cfg-val">'+cfg.inverter+'</span></div>';
      if(cfg.panels) html+='<div class="avl-cfg-row"><span class="avl-cfg-key"><i class="fa-solid fa-solar-panel" style="font-size:9px;margin-right:3px;"></i>Panels</span><span class="avl-cfg-val">'+cfg.panels+'</span></div>';
      html+='</div></div>';
    });
    html+='</div></div>';
  });
  if(!total) html='<div class="avl-no-results">No equipment configs match your filter.</div>';
  container.innerHTML=html;
}

/* ═══════════ ADDERS ═══════════ */
var ADDER_CAT_ORDER=['Batteries & Storage','Electrical','Roof','Installation','Home Services','Travel & Territory','Other'];
function categorizeAdder(name){
  var n=name.toLowerCase();
  if(n.includes('battery')||n.includes('powerwall')||n.includes('qcells')||n.includes('q.save')||n.includes('solaredge')||n.includes('span')||n.includes('backup')||n.includes('grid-tied'))return'Batteries & Storage';
  if(n.includes('travel')||n.includes('territory'))return'Travel & Territory';
  if(n.includes('roof')||n.includes('tile')||n.includes('flat roof')||n.includes('metal roof')||n.includes('stucco')||n.includes('re-roof')||n.includes('pitch'))return'Roof';
  if(n.includes('panel upgrade')||n.includes('subpanel')||n.includes('main breaker')||n.includes('derate')||n.includes('meter')||n.includes('load controller')||n.includes('line side')||n.includes('h-frame')||n.includes('relocation')||n.includes('hawaiian')||n.includes('production meter'))return'Electrical';
  if(n.includes('ev charger')||n.includes('nest')||n.includes('insulation')||n.includes('smart home')||n.includes('water efficiency')||n.includes('hvac'))return'Home Services';
  if(n.includes('ground mount')||n.includes('add on system')||n.includes('remove')||n.includes('pest')||n.includes('critter')||n.includes('tree')||n.includes('trench')||n.includes('shade')||n.includes('change order')||n.includes('small system')||n.includes('cold water')||n.includes('hurricane')||n.includes('certification'))return'Installation';
  return'Other';
}
function parseAdders(csv){
  var rows=parseCSV(csv);var items=[];
for(var i=3;i<rows.length;i++){var r=rows[i];var name=(r[1]||'').trim();if(!name)continue;items.push({name:name,q1:(r[2]||'').trim(),q2:(r[3]||'').trim(),q3:(r[4]||'').trim(),q4:(r[5]||'').trim(),note:(r[6]||'').trim()});}
  return items;
}
function renderAdders(items,filter,query){
  var container=document.getElementById('adder-content');if(!container)return;
  var q=(query||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  var filtered=items.filter(function(item){
    var cat=categorizeAdder(item.name);
    return(filter==='all'||cat===filter)&&(!q||(item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)||(item.note&&item.note.toLowerCase().includes(q))));
  });
  if(!filtered.length){container.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text3);">No adders found.</div>';return;}
  var groups={};filtered.forEach(function(item){var cat=categorizeAdder(item.name);if(!groups[cat])groups[cat]=[];groups[cat].push(item);});
  var orderedCats=ADDER_CAT_ORDER.filter(function(c){return groups[c];});
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(c){if(orderedCats.indexOf(c)===-1)orderedCats.push(c);});
  var html='';
  orderedCats.forEach(function(cat){
    if(!groups[cat])return;
    html+='<div class="adder-section-hdr">'+cat+'</div>';
    html+='<div class="adder-table-wrap"><table class="adder-table"><thead><tr><th>Adder</th><th>Qty 1</th><th>Qty 2</th><th>Qty 3</th><th>Qty 4</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    groups[cat].forEach(function(item){
      html+='<tr><td><div class="adder-name">'+item.name+'</div>'+(item.note?'<div class="adder-note">'+item.note+'</div>':'')+'</td>';
      [item.q1,item.q2,item.q3,item.q4].forEach(function(v){html+=v?'<td><span class="adder-price-val">'+v+'</span></td>':'<td><span class="adder-price-empty">—</span></td>';});
      html+='</tr>';
    });
    html+='</tbody></table></div>';
  });
  container.innerHTML=html;
}
function buildAdderFilterBar(items){
  var bar=document.getElementById('adder-filter-bar');if(!bar||bar.children.length>0)return;
  var cats=['all'].concat(ADDER_CAT_ORDER.filter(function(c){return items.some(function(i){return categorizeAdder(i.name)===c;});}));
  cats.forEach(function(cat){
    var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='adder-filter-btn'+(cat===adderActiveFilter?' active':'');btn.textContent=cat==='all'?'All Categories':cat;
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      adderActiveFilter=cat;bar.querySelectorAll('.adder-filter-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('active');});btn.classList.add('active');
      renderAdders(adderData,adderActiveFilter,document.getElementById('adder-srch').value);
    });
    bar.appendChild(btn);
  });
}
function loadAdders(){
  if(adderLoaded)return;
  var today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),cacheKey='lgcy-adders-'+today;
  var meta=document.getElementById('adder-meta'),container=document.getElementById('adder-content');
  if(container) container.innerHTML='<div class="spinner"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading live adder pricing…</div>';
  try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.startsWith('lgcy-adders-')&&k!==cacheKey)localStorage.removeItem(k);});var cached=localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if(cached){adderData=JSON.parse(cached);adderLoaded=true;buildAdderFilterBar(adderData);renderAdders(adderData,adderActiveFilter,'');
      if(meta)meta.innerHTML='<span class="live-badge cached"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt" style="font-size:9px;"></i> Cached today</span> &nbsp;·&nbsp; '+adderData.length+' adders';
      var srch=document.getElementById('adder-srch');if(srch)srch.addEventListener('input',function(){renderAdders(adderData,adderActiveFilter,this.value);});return;}
  }catch(e){}
  fetch(ADDER_URL).then(function(r){return r.text();}).then(function(csv){
    adderData=parseAdders(csv);adderLoaded=true;
    try{localStorage.setItem(cacheKey,JSON.stringify(adderData));}catch(e){}
    buildAdderFilterBar(adderData);renderAdders(adderData,adderActiveFilter,'');
    var now=new Date();if(meta)meta.innerHTML='<span class="live-badge"><span class="live-dot"></span> Live · '+now.toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})+'</span> &nbsp;·&nbsp; '+adderData.length+' adders';
    var srch=document.getElementById('adder-srch');if(srch)srch.addEventListener('input',function(){renderAdders(adderData,adderActiveFilter,this.value);});
  }).catch(function(){if(container)container.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text3);">Failed to load. Check connection.</div>';});
}

function refreshAVL(){
  try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.startsWith('lgcy-avl-'))localStorage.removeItem(k);});}catch(e){}
  avlLoaded=false;loadAVL();
}
window.refreshAVL=refreshAVL;
function refreshAdders(){
  var today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  try{localStorage.removeItem('lgcy-adders-'+today);}catch(e){}
  adderLoaded=false;adderData=[];
  var bar=document.getElementById('adder-filter-bar');if(bar)bar.innerHTML='';
  loadAdders();
}
window.refreshAdders=refreshAdders;

function switchContact(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ct-tab').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.ct===tab);});
  document.getElementById('ct-panel-lgcy').style.display=tab==='lgcy'?'':'none';
  document.getElementById('ct-panel-tools').style.display=tab==='tools'?'':'none';
}
window.switchContact=switchContact;

/* ═══════════ INIT ═══════════ */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  document.getElementById('theme-btn').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);
  document.getElementById('hdr-logo').addEventListener('click', function(){switchPane('home');});

  var srch=document.getElementById('srch');
  srch.addEventListener('focus', openSearch);srch.addEventListener('click', openSearch);
  document.getElementById('srch-ov-cancel').addEventListener('click', closeSearch);
  document.getElementById('srch-ov-input').addEventListener('input', function(){renderSearchResults(this.value);});

  document.querySelectorAll('.seg-btn').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){switchMode(btn.dataset.mode);});});
  document.querySelectorAll('.bnav-btn').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){switchPane(btn.dataset.bnav);});});

  var qaMap={
    'okta':function(){openGuide('https://scribehow.com/viewer/Receiving_OKTA_access_for_the_First_time__YQqnkyuLSdyVZam-le0kwQ','OKTA Access – First Time');},
    'canvass':function(){openGuide('https://scribehow.com/viewer/Loging_into_Canvass__19QG4BUqRkqC_VMAXih3hg','Downloading & Accessing Canvass');},
    'aurora':function(){openGuide('https://scribehow.com/viewer/Design_Mode__4N9yUaT5Q-27l1Y3d4BuRw','Aurora Design Mode');},
    'welcome':function(){openGuide('https://scribehow.com/viewer/Welcome_Call_Check_List_LGCY__SIc8hOF_TyGrjV08qFYUwQ','Welcome Call Checklist');},
    'adders':function(){switchPane('avl',{adderTab:true});},
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-qa]').forEach(function(btn){var fn=qaMap[btn.dataset.qa];if(fn)btn.addEventListener('click',fn);});

  var opClose=document.getElementById('op-close'),opOv=document.getElementById('op-overlay'),opIf=document.getElementById('op-iframe');
  if(opClose) opClose.addEventListener('click',function(){opOv.classList.remove('open');opIf.src='';});
  if(opOv) opOv.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this){this.classList.remove('open');opIf.src='';}});
  var cmpOv=document.getElementById('cmp-overlay');
  if(cmpOv) cmpOv.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this)closeCompare();});

  document.getElementById('vback').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('gframe').src='';
    document.getElementById('pane-viewer').classList.remove('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active');});
    var prev=document.getElementById('pane-'+prevPane);
    if(prev)prev.classList.add('active');else document.getElementById('pane-home').classList.add('active');
    currentPane=prevPane;
    var sw=document.getElementById('seg-wrap');if(sw) sw.style.display=(currentPane==='sheets'||currentPane==='videos'||currentPane==='home')?'':'none';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.bnav-btn').forEach(function(btn){btn.addEventListener('click',function(){switchPane(btn.dataset.bnav);});});

  document.querySelectorAll('.avl-tab').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var tab = btn.dataset.avltab;
      document.querySelectorAll('.avl-tab').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('active');});
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('avl-panel-finance').style.display = tab==='finance' ? '' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('avl-panel-equip').style.display   = tab==='equip'   ? '' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('avl-panel-adders').style.display  = tab==='adders'  ? '' : 'none';
      if(tab==='equip'  && !avlLoaded) loadAVL();
      if(tab==='adders' && !adderLoaded) loadAdders();
    });
  });

  renderSidebar();
  renderAllGuides();
  renderFavs();
  renderGuideCatBar();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
